title: Bada'i' al-Sana'i' fi Tartib al-Shara'i'
author: al-kasani
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Kasani's systematic restatement of Hanafi law. Where earlier works list cases, the Bada'i' orders each subject by its pillars, conditions and effects and gives the reasoning for every ruling, which made it the school's most admired work of legal architecture.
historicalContext: Written as a commentary on his teacher al-Samarqandi's Tuhfat al-Fuqaha, the book is said to have won al-Kasani the hand of his teacher's daughter. He later taught in Aleppo, where the work circulated and became a standard reference.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
